scope.title: Panels & distribution
scope.text: HT/LT panels, Capacitor Panels, MDBs, Distribution Boards along with accessories.

scope.title: Containment
scope.text: Conduit in slabs, walls and floors; sleeves and back boxes; GI cable trays, ladders, trunking and raceways.

scope.title: Wiring & cabling
scope.text: Power and lighting wiring, DB-to-equipment wiring, HT/LT cable laying, dressing, tagging, glanding and termination.

scope.title: Busducts & rising mains
scope.text: Busbar trunking and rising mains, supplied through OEM channels and installed to approved GA drawings.

scope.title: Lighting & accessories
scope.text: LED fixtures, lighting management systems, switches and sockets, fans and junction boxes.

scope.title: Critical power
scope.text: UPS and battery installation, server-room electrical works, AC unit connections, pumps and motors.

scope.title: Earthing & protection
scope.text: Earth pits and grids, GI and copper strip, surge protection devices and lightning arresters.

scope.title: Testing
scope.text: Megger, IR and continuity tests, panel load tests, circuit verification and HT/LT equipment testing.

scope.title: Fire Safety
scope.text: Fire alarm and detection systems, emergency lighting and power supply to fire-fighting equipment, installed and tested to approved drawings and local fire norms.

stages.title: Design
stages.text: We review the GFC drawings, then prepare shop and GA drawings to site conditions for approval by the PMC or consultant.

stages.title: Procurement
stages.text: Final quantities go to procurement alongside design. Vendors are validated and material is checked against the BOQ.

stages.title: Construction
stages.text: We secure the site, stage materials and carry out the works to approved drawings and method statements, under a risk assessment.

stages.title: Testing & commissioning
stages.text: Functional and visual checks, quality and safety inspections, and test reports from our own commissioning team.
stages.tags: Megger & IR, Panel load, System test

stages.title: Handover
stages.text: As-built drawings, test reports and warranties. Snags are closed, the client’s team is trained, and a final walkthrough leads to sign-off.
